snippet.title: PNEUMA Official Demo Trailer - Demo Out Now! #indiehorrorgame #indiehorror #coophorror
snippet.description:
Demo Out Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4999110/PNEUMA_Demo/

PNEUMA AT A GLANCE
- Co-op for up to 4 players online (can also be played single player)
- Classic ghost hunting equipment with a sci-fi twist: Dark Matter Field Detector, Gravity Sensor, Thermometer, Lidar Scanner and more
- 17+ ghost types, each with unique behaviours
- Possession: get caught and the ghost may take over your body and turn it on your team
- Speak rituals aloud with your own voice to bind, expose or provoke the ghost
- Localized in English, Japanese, Italian, Russian, German, French, Simplified Chinese and Spanish
- PC (Steam)
